pending-clause.answer: §2002:15 and 15.1 differ from 2023 only in wording that 2023 moved (the per-function size sentences become the type sentence of §2023:15.2) and in 2023 additions (file-name and variable-length-group arguments, renumbering). The rule decides whether a name resolves to a user-defined function or an intrinsic one; it does not rest on what a type or argument kind is. Scope and the p09-udf-shadow / p09-no-repo evidence at 2002 are unchanged.
